question_text: According to the course material, Weihrich and Koontz say that management as a process is designing and maintaining an environment in which individuals, working together in groups:
option_a: efficiently accomplish selected aims
option_b: avoid all group work by design
option_c: maximise only the personal wealth of the founder
option_d: replace every worker with a machine immediately
explanation: Weihrich and Koontz define management as designing and maintaining an environment in which individuals, working together in groups, efficiently accomplish selected aims.

question_text: According to the course material, the managerial functions commonly referred to include planning, organizing, staffing, leading and:
option_a: controlling among others
explanation: The functions are planning, organizing, staffing, leading and controlling among others.

question_text: According to the course material, management applies to:
option_a: any kind of organization as long as human and other resources are there
option_b: only the Nigeria Bottling Company Plc
explanation: Management is not restricted to any particular organization; any organization with human and other resources calls for management, including churches, mosques and clubs.

question_text: According to the course material, the aim of all managers, whether senior or junior, is the same: it is to:
option_a: make surplus or what some people called profit
explanation: The aim of all managers is to make surplus or profit by using resources without wastage.

question_text: According to the course material, all non-profit making organizations should at least aim at the break-even point, which is simply the point where:
option_a: revenue is equal to the amount of money being spent
option_b: revenue is always far above spending by law
option_d: customers are charged the highest possible price
explanation: Break-even is where revenue equals money spent. Non-profits should aim at this point because they are not supposed to charge customers so much as to realize surplus.

question_text: According to the course material, the two main types of cost are the fixed cost and:
option_a: variable cost
explanation: There are two main types of cost: fixed cost and variable cost. Their addition gives total cost.

question_text: According to the course material, fixed costs such as machines and buildings are there:
option_a: whether you are producing just one unit or a million units of the product
explanation: Fixed costs such as machines and buildings remain whether you produce one unit or a million units.

question_text: According to the course material, with increased volume of production the unit cost of the product is going to be:
option_a: lower
explanation: Higher volume divides total cost into a smaller unit cost.

question_text: According to the course material, one of the most important activities of human beings is managing, and the idea of managing group resources started:
option_a: even since human beings started coming together and working in groups
explanation: Managing group resources started when human beings began coming together and working in groups so that group objectives can be attained.

question_text: According to the course material, the course writer concludes that management belongs to science, but:
option_a: not an exact science; it is in the social sciences
option_b: an exact laboratory science like chemistry
option_c: not a science in any sense
option_d: only an art with no body of knowledge
explanation: Management has the features of science as an organized body of knowledge, but it is not an exact science; it is in the social sciences.

question_text: According to the course material, top level management is the same as Administration because they are concerned with:
option_a: policy formulation and standards through which performance can be measured
explanation: Top level management is the same as Administration because they formulate policy and set standards through which performance can be measured.

question_text: According to the course material, whereas Administration is largely at the top, management however:
option_a: permeates the entire organization
explanation: Administration is largely at the top; management permeates the entire organization.

question_text: According to the course material, at the top level, managers spend more time on planning and organizing, which the material treats as:
option_a: administration
explanation: At the top level, managers spend more time on planning and organizing (administration).

question_text: According to the course material, leading the subordinates in executing what has been planned takes a great deal of time of:
option_a: low level managers (supervisors)
explanation: Low level managers (supervisors) spend a great deal of time leading subordinates in executing what has been planned.

question_text: According to the course material, middle level managers devote equal time to planning, organizing and leading, that is equal time to:
option_a: administration and execution
explanation: Middle level managers devote equal time to administration and execution.

question_text: According to the course material, the manager operates in two environments: the internal environment and the external environment, and he has control over:
option_a: the internal environment in the process of managing
explanation: The manager has control over the internal environment; he has little or no control over external factors and must respond to them.

question_text: According to the course material, the physical environment relates to land area, climate, topography, drainage, vegetation and soil types, and Nigeria has an estimated area of:
option_a: 941,849 square kilometre, incorporating a wide area of arable land
explanation: Nigeria has an estimated area of 941,849 square kilometres with a wide area of arable land.

question_text: According to the course material, the manager must register his business through the appropriate Nigerian law, such as the Registration of Business name Act of 1961, the Partnership Law of the states, and:
option_a: the Companies and Allied Matters Decree (CAMD) of 1990
option_b: only a village custom with no statute
explanation: Registration may be under the Registration of Business Names Act 1961, state Partnership Laws, or CAMD 1990, depending on the form of business.

question_text: According to the course material, advantages of sole proprietorship include that it is simple to start, a small registration fee is required, there is minimum government regulation, the owner is the overall boss and:
option_a: all profits belong to the owner
option_b: liability is always limited by shares
explanation: Sole proprietorship advantages include simplicity, small fee, minimum regulation, the owner as boss, and all profits belonging to the owner.

question_text: According to the course material, a disadvantage of sole proprietorship is that there is:
option_a: unlimited liability
explanation: Disadvantages of sole proprietorship include difficulty raising capital, unlimited liability and a high failure rate.

question_text: According to the course material, partnership is formed by at least two persons, and death of a partner:
option_a: brings the partnership to an end
option_b: has no effect on the firm
option_c: automatically converts it to a public company
option_d: transfers all shares to the state
explanation: A partnership is formed by at least two persons; death of a partner brings the partnership to an end.

question_text: According to the course material, an objective generally is an end in view: it represents the point an organization wants to attain and it is:
option_a: futuristic, that is, it concerns the future
option_b: only a record of last year's accounts
option_d: the same as a raw material invoice
explanation: An objective is an end in view and is futuristic; enterprise activities must be directed towards the set objectives.

question_text: According to the course material, characteristics of a good objective include that it must be specific, action-oriented, realistic, measurable and:
option_a: time bound
explanation: A good objective must be specific, command action, be realistic, be measurable/quantified, and be time bound.

question_text: According to the course material, for the Nigerian environment which is erratic and turbulent, short term objective is usually:
option_a: less than one year
explanation: In the Nigerian environment, short term objective is usually less than one year.

question_text: According to the course material, human skills are the ability to work with people; they involve cooperating as a team by creating an environment where people feel:
option_a: secured and free to express their opinions
explanation: Human skills are the ability to work with people in an environment where people feel secured and free to express their opinions.

question_text: According to the course material, conceptual skill is the ability to see the big picture of the end in view, while design skill is the ability to:
option_a: solve problems in ways that will benefit the organization by working out practical solutions
explanation: Conceptual skill sees the big picture; design skill solves problems with practical solutions that benefit the organization.

question_text: According to the course material, forecasting is a management function that reduces areas of uncertainty that surround management decision, and it is aimed at:
option_a: calculating or predicting what is likely going to happen in the future
explanation: Forecasting calculates or predicts future events or conditions in advance and gives management the basis for expecting a desired outcome.

question_text: According to the course material, planning involves deciding in advance what to do, how to do it, when to do it and:
option_a: who is to do it
explanation: Planning involves deciding in advance what to do, how to do it, when to do it and who is to do it.

question_text: According to the course material, steps in planning include define the problem, collect relevant data, develop alternative solutions, assess consequences, select the maximum solution, implement action and:
option_a: measure result
explanation: The steps are: define the problem/issue; collect relevant data; develop alternative solutions; assess the consequences; select the maximum solution; implement action; measure result.

question_text: According to the course material, disadvantages of planning include that it depends on the quality of data, it is expensive in time and money, and:
option_a: planning delays action because action waits until the plan is completed
explanation: Planning can be harmed by poor data, is expensive, and delays action until the plan is completed.
